overview: Hop is a 2011 American Easter comedy film directed by Tim Hill and written by Cinco Paul, Ken Daurio, and Brian Lynch, from a story by Paul and Daurio. Produced by Universal Pictures, Illumination Entertainment and Relativity Media, it stars James Marsden, Kaley Cuoco, Gary Cole, Elizabeth Perkins, David Hasselhoff, and Chelsea Handler, with the voices of Russell Brand, Hank Azaria, and Hugh Laurie. The film follows a young rabbit (Brand) who would rather drum in a band than succeed his father (Laurie) as the Easter Bunny, and befriends a human slacker (Marsden) seeking a job.
